Style.consistency: the same outline weight, the same eye style, the same chibi proportions and the same scale for every creature

Items.name: microbe
Items.description: a round blob-shaped single cell in light green, with a darker green nucleus spot, a few short wiggly cilia around its edge, and a happy face

Items.name: jellyfish
Items.description: a dome-shaped jellyfish in sky blue with a cyan highlight, four short curly tentacles below, and a happy face on the dome

Items.name: trilobite
Items.description: a trilobite seen from above at a slight angle: an oval segmented grey shell with dark grey grooves, small antennae, and a happy face on the head shield

Items.name: fish
Items.description: a plump orange fish with a yellow belly, a forked tail fin, and a happy face; side view facing the viewer's left

Items.name: frog
Items.description: a round green frog sitting upright, yellow belly, large eyes on top of its head, wide smile

Items.name: lizard
Items.description: a small green lizard standing on four legs, curled tail, yellow belly stripe, happy face

Items.name: dinosaur
Items.description: a friendly long-necked dinosaur in green with a yellow belly and darker green back spots, standing on four sturdy legs

Items.name: bird
Items.description: a round sky blue songbird with a yellow beak, a white belly and small wings raised, standing

Items.name: mouse
Items.description: a round grey mouse sitting up, large round ears with red inner ears, a long thin tail, a pink-red nose

Items.name: primate
Items.description: a small orange-brown monkey sitting, a tan face and tan belly, round ears, a curled tail

Items.name: human
Items.description: a cheerful cave-person child with tan skin, brown shaggy hair, and a simple orange one-shoulder tunic, waving one hand

Context.game: a sliding evolution puzzle on a 4 by 4 board
Context.why: one picture for each level of the evolution chain; two equal creatures merge into the next
